audit.why: Seraphine is an immobile poke/enchant mage with no dash — she loses lane hard to a level-1/2 hook all-in and only stabilizes once Surround Sound's shield/heal comes online; the level chart correctly favors Nautilus every stage.
Key spikes are level 2 (Q + passive all-in before Beat Drop is up), level 6 (point-click Depth Charge beats a telegraphed Encore), and first item (Q/E force her E defensively).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Beat Drop as matchup-defining but has no cooldown number; the missingInteractions flag Surround Sound's heal (Grievous Wounds timing) and Stage Presence's auto-attack-reset combo tell as unaddressed.
audit.why: The applier/lint requires a digit in breakdown.cooldowns, and both flagged interactions are real, checkable facts from the kit that change how the matchup should be played (when to hold anti-heal, when to back off during her combo wind-up).
audit.corrected: Added the real Beat Drop cooldown (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) to breakdown.cooldowns, folded the Stage Presence auto-reset tell into breakdown.early, and added the Surround Sound anti-heal timing to the itemization report entry.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the engage you don't use governs more than the one you do.
edits.after: Watch for Stage Presence's auto-attack reset wind-up — that's her combo opening, not the spell cast, so step off before Beat Drop even fires. Zone with the hook threat and the engage you don't use still governs the lane.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Encore's range refreshes on every champion it hits, so once you land the chain her follow-up charm threat resets to nothing — commit through it, not around it.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Wasted Q hooks hand her a free poke window, and Stage Presence's third-cast bonus autoattack punishes every whiffed engage timer.
